title: Signal: Dependency metadata rewritten by package extensions
scope: A .yarnrc.yml file that declares a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package.
limitations: It matches a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package in the parsed .yarnrc.yml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .yarnrc.yml that mentions a `packageExtensions` block that rewrites the metadata of a published package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
